title: Rewind Studio: Guided Incident Replay + Payload-Guided Repair Flow
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact workspace inside the Redwood Console to let engineers triage failed requests end-to-end: timeline rewind, request snapshots, structured payload inspectors, retry simulator, and guided remediation suggestions. The goal is to reduce MTTR for intermittent LLM inference errors by making root-cause signals (model variant, tokenization, KV cache hit/miss, quantization fallbacks, routing policy) visible and actionable. This ticket covers mid-fidelity prototypes, interaction specs, and handoff notes to frontend and research for an initial canary in console-2025.03.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace opens as a modal OR side-dock from any failed request row and preserves request context
Timeline scrub shows capture of upstream events (routing, batching, cache decisions) and highlights first observed error event
Payload inspector renders raw JSON, parsed structured output, and a diff against previous successful request when available
Retry simulator allows changing routing/model variant and shows estimated latency/cost delta without executing production traffic
Guided remediation suggestions surface likely causes with links to runbooks and one-click create-ticket for infra/ops
All interactions have keyboard access and pass WCAG contrast checks for primaries
